newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent steady after profit taking in London.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent steady after profit taking in London.

text.p: untraded at midday on Friday but remained rangebound after sharp
August Brent on SIMEX was quoted at $18.10/18.28, in line with the London close of $18.21 after falling 71 cents.
Brokers said the fall in IPE Brent was mainly the result of profit taking by traders, although news that Iraqi crude exports was a step closer to resumption was also a factor.
"Thursday is the day when the market usually corrects itself, as traders take account of their positions" said a broker.
But brokers expected levels to move up rather than down, after bouncing off a trendline support of $18.18.
